body: so emotional about how this all started 🧡 the very first entry in our End Game thread is july 2023: a friendship bracelet with his number on it that Travis never got to give Taylor. the newest, from nov. 11 this year, is him calling her "my wife." https://www.longlivets.com/?lens=the-proposal&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread
why: Calendar 11-26 End Game thread hero, behind-the-data angle, 16:00Z variant carrying the 11-24 experiment verbatim. Counts made this run off the seed (every supabase/seed/content/*.mjs record whose threadIds includes the-proposal): 37 moments; by year 2023:3, 2024:6, 2025:13, 2026:15; earliest is the friendship-bracelet record (midnights.mjs, July 2023, Travis on New Heights); newest is showgirl-new-heights-tailgate-stage-joke, Nov. 11, 2026 ("my wife"). X carries the first/newest entries, IG the counts. Thanksgiving warmth without making it about the holiday. Photo is the pre-computed pick (GMA 2012); loosely related.

critique.rationale: Feeling first, then the thread's first and newest sourced entries as bookends: the bracelet he never handed over, and "my wife". Different statistic from the IG half; the photo is a credited Taylor portrait.
